_comment: Owned by Rae. Agents: propose changes in your report, never edit. Baselines quoted are from benchmarks/baselines/synth200_s0.json (scorecard v2 + SMARTS-like differential rotation in synthetic.make_suite, 2026-10-13). 'success' = correct (within REL_TOL of P_eq) + diffrot (within the active-latitude-band period range). status: draft = reported only; active = enforced (check_goals exits 1 on FAIL); met = achieved, kept as a record. synth200_s0_v1_scorecard1.json is the pre-diffrot baseline (different synthetic population), kept for history only. G9-G12 (2026-10-21) are on real SMARTS dev_medium full-year, the default judging set for method changes (Rae); synthetic goals G1-G8 remain as regression checks. H1-H5 (2026-11-13, Rae: headline-card recommendations) grade tools/headline_card.py's headline.json; RT1a/b grade scorecard runtime (free, draft); RT2 grades benchmarks/profile_pipeline.py --summary-json, run occasionally.

goals.description: Overall success, i.e. measured a physical rotation period (baseline 0.67).
Success for P_eq<1d (baseline 0.65). Task T5.
Some Stage-1 method lists a success period, P_eq<1d (baseline 0.88). Task T5.
Success 10-30d (baseline 0.70 although Stage-1 recall is 0.98: an arbitration problem). Tasks T6/P1/T11.
guess_pairwise_histogram never raises (baseline: raises on 27.5% of stars). Task T4 / open issue 8. MET 2026-10-13 (T4 merged).
Confidently-wrong answers are costlier than declining (baseline 0.055).

Fewer declines on measurable stars (baseline 0.24). High-SNR (5-20) stars are declined as often as SNR<2 (29%), and solar-like shear raises declines; some declines (near pole-on) are legitimate. Robustness to differential rotation.
No guess_* method ever raises (generalizes G5; T15). Any new method is covered automatically. Added 2026-10-14 on Rae's approval.

Real-data overall success (baseline 0.248). Baseline from benchmarks/baselines/dev_medium_fullyear.json (T2, 2026-10-15). Real SMARTS noise; the achievable ceiling is unknown until T3 / T20 explain how much signal is recoverable, so these are first guesses.

Real-data confident-wrong rate (baseline 0.088; 0 on synthetic). Honest decline beats wrong. Baseline from benchmarks/baselines/dev_medium_fullyear.json (T2, 2026-10-15). Real-data Stage-1 recall for P<1d (baseline 0.44; 0.88 on synthetic). Relates to P16. Baseline from benchmarks/baselines/dev_medium_fullyear.json (T2, 2026-10-15). Real SMARTS noise; the achievable ceiling is unknown until T3 / T20 explain how much signal is recoverable, so these are first guesses.
Headline R1: assigned, TESS coverage mix, P <= 30 d, shipped system (ranker). Baseline ranker v0 0.198 +/- 0.028. Rae 2026-11-13.
Headline R3 guard: correct-only (no diffrot credit), full-year; no drop > 0.02 (~1 SE) vs --baseline headline.json.
Headline R4: precision at f = 0.1, full-year; ranker >= hand arbitration (the 'match hand' default). v0: 0.534 vs 0.711.
Headline R4: precision at f = 0.1, assigned; ranker >= hand. v0: 0.251 vs 0.206.
Headline R5: within 20%, most credible half, full-year; Claytor+2022's 0.69. v0 0.642 +/- 0.023.
Headline R2 guard: success, full-year, dev_medium population; no drop > 0.02 vs --baseline headline.json.
Runtime, free on every scorecard: median s/star no more than 25% above the baseline's. Draft (reported only): parallel wall time moves with machine load.
Same as RT1a, assigned coverage.

Runtime, occasional (idle machine, serial, ~2 min): profile_pipeline.py --star-ids-file benchmarks/profile_stars.txt --ignore-manifest-sectors --features --repeats 3 --summary-json; no more than 10% slower than benchmarks/baselines/profile15_fullyear_v7.json. Run before merging speed-relevant changes, not on every update.
